scenario: Keep a full-load turnaround safe and prove it, across a single shift.
timeframe: One 12-hour shift, inside a multi-week turnaround.
baselineNote: Out of 10, on a turnaround day.

phases.name: Start of shift situational awareness
phases.action: Ask "where do things stand, and what is riskiest right now?" and start assembling the answer by hand.
phases.thought: I can see permits issued, but not whether the riskiest jobs are where they should be.
painPoints: The riskiest jobs are invisible until someone walks the unit
phases.opportunity: One validated briefing that flags the riskiest jobs at the top.
phases.momentLabel: The first-coffee question — does the GM start the day blind or briefed?

phases.name: High-risk work authorization
phases.action: Decide whether hot work, confined space entry and work at height can proceed today.
phases.thought: Is this confined-space entry actually set up the way the permit says?
painPoints: Permit conditions and real conditions are not connected
phases.opportunity: Drill into any high-risk job and see permit conditions, who is inside, gas test status and standby confirmation.
phases.momentLabel: The confined-space authorization — managed, or hoped?

phases.name: In-shift monitoring
phases.action: Track the surge as contractor density peaks; watch for jobs drifting out of permit conditions.
phases.thought: The headcounts do not agree, so which number do I trust?
phases.opportunity: Live flags for any job in a hazard zone without a valid permit, each with an evidence trail.

phases.name: Incident or muster
phases.thought: Who is unaccounted for, and where were they last?
painPoints: Muster by manual list takes far too long when it matters most
phases.opportunity: Live muster status by zone in seconds, with last-known location for anyone missing.

phases.name: Reporting and audit readiness
phases.action: Report safety numbers that must be defensible.
phases.thought: Can I defend every number if the auditor asks?
painPoints: Numbers are reconstructed after the fact, without a clear trail
phases.opportunity: Every figure current and traceable to source, with anything questionable already flagged.

traceability.painPoint: No single trusted view of the riskiest jobs
Permit conditions not connected to real conditions
Sources disagree, problems found by accident

traceability.signal: Turnaround idle time from permit verification
